name: hn_who_is_hiring-mcp
display_name: Hacker News: Who is hiring? MCP
description: Hacker News: Who is hiring? (jobs): get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v0/item/<id>.json for one 'Who is hiring?' comment (ids are in the monthly thread's kids[]). A hiring comment has no title, so title and description both carry the comment's HTML text (its first line is usually 'Company | Role | Location'); company is the poster's HN username (`by`); time (Unix) stays in raw. A missing item answers null (invalid_input).
